title: Invoices received after month-end for prior-period expenses not accrued
prompt: Review invoices received after month-end and identify expenses relating to the prior period that have not been accrued.

setup.q: How many days after month-end are invoices still reviewed for the prior period (the close cutoff)?
Up to what amount may an accrual with a stated service period be proposed for one-click approval (tier A)?
Which ledger account holds accrued expenses?

inputs.name: Bills received after the period end up to the close cutoff

steps: read the period-lock state for the month; a closed period is a question, not a proposal
run Dime's cutoff scan and pull bills dated or received after period end up to the close cutoff day
for each bill read the service period on the invoice; a bill whose service falls in the prior period and has no accrual in the ledger is an exception
exclude bills already accrued, already posted in the period, or for goods received after period end; say which rule excluded each
propose each accrual dated the period end with its reversal dated the first day of the next period; tier A at or below the ceiling with a stated service period, tier B otherwise
tie: proposed accruals plus existing accruals equal the accrued expenses the Tie-out states

done.text: No two proposals accrue the same vendor, amount and period, and no bill already accrued or posted is proposed again
Every accrual and reversal balances to the penny
Every exception row cites the bill id and the ledger search that found no accrual
unrecorded-liabilities.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every accrual is paired with its reversal; the service period comes from the invoice, and a bill with no stated service period is proposed at tier B with the assumption written down

tierRules.when: amount at or below {{setup.accrualCeiling}} and the invoice states the service period
amount above {{setup.accrualCeiling}} or the service period is not stated on the invoice
